title: FizzBuzz, Go Style
story: The classic interview warm-up. Order of the checks matters.
goal: Write FizzBuzz(n int) string: Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for 5, FizzBuzz for both, else the number as text.

tests.label: main prints 1 to 15
tests.expect:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz

hints: Check the combined case (divisible by 3 and 5) first.
A tagless switch with case n%15 == 0 reads nicely.
socratic: Which number is divisible by both 3 and 5?
What happens if you test n%3 before n%15?
How do you turn an int into a string?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “FizzBuzz, Go Style”?
